name: Basewright: Apply
description: Turn a plan into a running instance. The only template that changes a machine. It takes a plan id and no host: the plan says which machine it was built for, and asking again would be asking somebody to repeat something the artifact already carries and to get it wrong. Refuses a plan that has been edited, a host that has drifted, and warnings nobody has acknowledged.

survey_vars.name: basewright_plan_id
survey_vars.title: Plan id
survey_vars.description: The id the Plan task printed. It is a digest of the plan's own content, so it is also a checksum: a plan that has been edited since it was approved no longer answers to this name.

survey_vars.name: basewright_accept_warnings
survey_vars.title: Warnings have been read
survey_vars.description: A plan with warnings will not apply until somebody says they have read them. There is no equivalent for a block and there never will be.

values.name: No -- stop if there are any
